issues.description: changedFiles path comparison lacks normalization, breaking cross-platform and absolute/relative path matching
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against this.changedFiles.includes(filename) using plain string equality. VitestGit returns whatever git produces, so mismatched separators on Windows or absolute-vs-relative paths cause every file to silently miss and coverage goes empty. Normalize changedFiles at assignment and document the precondition.

issues.description: findChangedFiles returning null silently disables filtering and reports coverage for all files
issues.detail: When VitestGit returns null (not a git repo, bad ref), onTestRunStart leaves changedFiles undefined and the code falls through to report coverage for ALL files instead of failing loudly. Users who asked for changed-only coverage get full coverage without warning. Warn or throw on this path.

issues.description: isIncluded postcondition depends on mutable changedFiles state set by sibling lifecycle method
issues.detail: isIncluded was a pure function of include/exclude globs; now its answer depends on this.changedFiles, populated later by onTestRunStart. globCache.clear() inside onTestRunStart papers over ordering, but the cache key is just filename and doesn't encode filter state. Key on (filename, hasChangedFilter) or pass changedFiles explicitly.

issues.description: CoverageProvider contract widened with optional onTestRunStart that BaseCoverageProvider depends on for correctness
issues.detail: Adding onTestRunStart as optional on CoverageProvider while BaseCoverageProvider relies on it to populate changedFiles means any custom provider that omits or overrides it silently loses changed-files filtering. Document the invariant or move the call into a non-overridable lifecycle hook.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook pasted into three call sites in core.ts instead of folded into start()
issues.detail: core.ts has three identical `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` lines after `_testRun.start(...)`. A fourth path added later will forget it. Fold into _testRun.start or a helper to avoid repeating the same special case.

issues.description: CLI transform handles boolean inputs that the CLI parser never produces
issues.detail: The transform checks `value === true` and `value === false`, but CLI args arrive as strings. Either the boolean|string type is leaking between layers or this is dead code. Narrow the transform's input type to string and let resolveConfig handle the boolean form.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is well-scoped but the file-path matching and provider lifecycle contracts are fragile. Path comparison between VitestGit output and slash(cleanUrl(...))-normalized filenames lacks explicit normalization, risking silent empty coverage on Windows or with mixed path forms. isIncluded's postcondition now depends on mutable changedFiles state populated by a sibling lifecycle hook, and the globCache key doesn't encode that filter state. Silent fallthrough when findChangedFiles returns null inverts user intent, and the optional onTestRunStart hook weakens the CoverageProvider contract for custom subclasses. NEEDS-WORK: normalize paths, fail loud on null, tighten the provider contract, and consolidate the three core.ts call sites.
